comment: cmd.c hangup() witness for its direct end_of_input() call (5175-5179). In debug mode an elven Wizard learns drain life from a wished blessed spellbook, drinks two wished blessed potions of gain energy, and casts the spell at himself; 'n' refuses the 'Die?' question. ^A repeats the cast, and this time 'y' accepts death, so really_done() runs while do_repeat() still has in_doagain set and has already cleared something_worth_saving (end.c:1148). The disclosure prompt reads its answer through readchar() (win/tty/topl.c tty_yn_function()), which takes pgetchar() under in_doagain, so the 0377 bytes reach hangup(); with nothing worth saving it calls end_of_input() at once, which saves nothing and ends the program.
